name: Contrast-X
description: Contrast-enhanced imaging is central to oncologic diagnosis, but contrast agents can be contraindicated for many of the patients who need them most. Synthesizing contrast scans from non-contrast inputs is the natural response. Two obstacles stand in the way: no benchmark provides paired contrast data with lesion-level evaluation, and no single model handles the arbitrary missing patterns seen in practice. We introduce Contrast-X, a benchmark of paired contrast-enhanced and non-contrast imaging spanning 10 organs in CT (1{,}526 patients) and multi-phase breast DCE-MRI (1116 patients).
